title: Android shell and navigation
acceptance_criteria: Installable Android build with five destinations and working back navigation.
evidence: Source implemented; validation recorded in docs/development/0.0.1-foundation.md; release gates pending.

title: Project catalogue and detail
acceptance_criteria: Browse local demo projects; view stage, ownership category, tags and details; empty/error states present.
evidence: Source implemented; validation recorded in docs/development/0.0.1-foundation.md; release gates pending.

title: Authentication and backend foundation
acceptance_criteria: Invite-only email/password sign-in/out, invitation password setup, encrypted sessions and backend permissions are verified; Google sign-in follows OAuth and account-linking review; public deployment prerequisites remain.
evidence: 64 PostgreSQL assertions and eight invitation tests passed; Android session/deep-link restart and live catalogue checks passed; local authorization regressions verified. In review; see docs/development/0.0.2-backend-accounts.md.

title: Member profiles and interests
acceptance_criteria: Edit own profile and interests; another member cannot edit it.
evidence: Profile visibility and cross-account authorization pass PostgreSQL tests; emulator verifies invited profile editing, process restoration, and encrypted logout cleanup. In review; see docs/development/0.0.2-backend-accounts.md.

title: Project following
acceptance_criteria: Follow/unfollow persists and duplicate follows are prevented.
evidence: Duplicate follow and unfollow retries pass PostgreSQL and emulator checks; follows restore across app restart. In review; see docs/development/0.0.2-backend-accounts.md.

title: Updates and comments
acceptance_criteria: Publish global/community text posts with hashtags, comments, nested replies and reactions; allow text/code selection and copy; official announcements require maintainer role; lists paginate.

title: Topic communities
acceptance_criteria: Discover shared topics and participate with visible author attribution.

title: Collaboration opportunities
acceptance_criteria: Maintainers publish requests with skills, terms and open/closed state; members respond.

title: Reports blocks and moderation
acceptance_criteria: Members report/block; authorized moderators review and record actions; verification badges are granted through an audited process; reporter access is restricted.

title: Private messaging
acceptance_criteria: Private real-time one-to-one text messages support quoted replies, read receipts and typing indicators; only participants access messages; retries do not duplicate sends; blocking prevents new contact.

title: Notifications and preferences
acceptance_criteria: Members control notifications; taps open authorised content; blocked contact cannot notify.

title: Search and discovery
acceptance_criteria: Search projects/topics by agreed fields with paginated results and empty states.

title: Recovery deletion and operations
acceptance_criteria: Recovery/deletion flows verified; support route, retention policy and tested backup restoration exist.

title: Accessibility and reliability refinement
acceptance_criteria: Text scaling, accessibility navigation, interrupted requests and agreed performance targets verified.

title: Member project publishing pilot
acceptance_criteria: Approved members publish projects; ownership and official/community distinction enforced.

title: Marketplace listings and enquiries
acceptance_criteria: Listings cover project opportunities, jobs, gigs and member services with accountable seller, description and enquiry route; report handling exists; checkout excluded.

title: Founder build and community controls
acceptance_criteria: Separate Founder APK with a sole server-provisioned Founder role and audited member, project, topic, post/comment moderation and app-setting controls; no embedded authority or general private-message access.
evidence: Member unit 22/22, Founder unit 30/30; API 36 emulator instrumentation: member 18 passed/1 backend-fixture skip, Founder 19 passed/1 skip; both flavors lint/build pass. PostgreSQL reset 201 pgTAP assertions; invitation function 9/9 tests and type-check pass; Founder R8 minification completes. Two-account live-backend verification pending. See docs/development/0.0.3-founder-build.md.

title: Organization profiles and teams
acceptance_criteria: Organizations have distinct pages for services, team members and updates; members control affiliation; permissions distinguish individual and organization actions.

title: Offline message cache
acceptance_criteria: Recent authorized conversations remain readable from a local database offline; writes clearly show queued versus server-accepted state.

title: Media posts and push notifications
acceptance_criteria: Members upload supported post images and receive preference-controlled push notifications that open content they may access.

title: Member and organization discovery
acceptance_criteria: Search people and organizations by agreed industry, skills, tech stack, location and role filters with pagination and privacy-aware visibility.

title: Web community administration dashboard
acceptance_criteria: Authorized staff review reports, moderate content, handle bans and manage community settings through audited server-checked controls.

title: Group direct messaging
acceptance_criteria: Group membership, message visibility, blocking, reporting and notification behavior are defined and tested before release.

title: 24-hour status stories
acceptance_criteria: Short-lived updates expire reliably and retain reporting, audience and moderation controls.

title: Voice and video calling
acceptance_criteria: Calls use an approved real-time transport with consent, blocking, abuse reporting and reliable connection-state handling.
